q: In an $(s, F)$ graph the force is a horizontal segment at the height $40\,\text{N}$ from $0\text{–}0.50\,\text{m}$. What does the area between the graph and the $s$-axis tell you, and how large is it?
a: The area tells you the work done by the force: $40\,\text{N} \cdot 0.50\,\text{m} = 20\,\text{J}$.
